field_semantics.owner: Runtime/process owner. Always 'deployment': the deployment layer owns process topology, persistence infrastructure, queues, schedulers, workers, secrets, runtime configuration, CI/CD, observability, scaling, backups, recovery and environment isolation for every deployed component.
field_semantics.layer: Architecture layer whose authority the component hosts: 'protocol' (hosts protocol-owned authority), 'product' (hosts product-owned presentation semantics), 'deployment' (pure deployment infrastructure; hosts no protocol or product authority).
field_semantics.authority_hosted: The authority the component hosts. Components with layer 'protocol' list the protocol authorities they host; every other component's value must start with 'none' — financial authority exists only in protocol-layer components.
field_semantics.exists_in_repository_today: True only if the component's entrypoint paths exist in the repository at the declared base SHA. False means FUTURE-WORK: the component is deployment-owned capacity whose repository entrypoint arrives with the referenced future work.
field_semantics.repository_entrypoint: Object with 'status' ('present' or 'future-work'), 'paths' (repository-relative paths; non-empty and on disk when present; empty when future-work) and 'marker' (dependency-graph provenance; required when future-work).
field_semantics.route_surface: Optional: HTTP routes served by the component (documentation; not an existence-checked entrypoint).
field_semantics.environment_reachability: Canonical environment classes in which the component may run. Reachability is topology only: production reachability additionally requires the production_gate.
field_semantics.production_gate: Required whenever 'production' is reachable: the separately authorized production configuration that gates real financial effects. Sandbox/demo can never reach production financial effects without it (environments.md fail-closed rules F1-F8).
field_semantics.health_signal: Contract-level health signal the component must expose; bound to observability from DEP-002 onward.
field_semantics.rollback: Contract-level rollback mechanism; principles R1-R5 in spec/deployment/topology.md.

components.name: Web/API boundary — PaySwap Next.js application
components.authority_hosted: none — hosts product-owned navigation, presentation and progressive disclosure (shell home '/', verification surface '/state-primitives') plus the server-side environment signal; hosts no financial authority, never writes authoritative state, never reaches external rails
components.production_gate: Production traffic is served only from the production environment with its separately authorized production configuration; PAYSWAP_ENV=production is set only there (environments.md fail-closed rules F2/F3).
components.health_signal: Process boot plus HTTP readiness: GET / returns 200 and the shell renders; the environment signal resolves to an allowlisted value (fail-safe 'sandbox' otherwise).
components.rollback: Stateless redeploy of the previous commit/build artifact; the shell holds no authoritative state, so rollback requires no data recovery.

components.name: Protocol gateway — authoritative protocol API
components.authority_hosted: protocol authorities per the system architecture hard boundaries — identity, authority, values, accounting, intent, demand, capability, market, liquidity, credit, reservations, routing/compiler, execution admission, clearing, obligations, risk/compliance, recourse, federation — enforced inside a deployment-owned process; the sole admission point for protocol commands

repository_entrypoint.marker: FUTURE-WORK: protocol runtime per dependency graph WORK-001..WORK-033; infrastructure binding from DEP-002 onward

components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration (DEP-002+ secret binding); sandbox/demo configuration can never reach production financial effects (environments.md F1-F8).
components.health_signal: Readiness endpoint; command acceptance rate and latency; durable-queue submit success (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact; in-flight commands replay from the durable command queue; rollback never mutates authoritative state directly.

components.name: Transition runtime — single authoritative-state writer
components.authority_hosted: authoritative state transitions — execution, clearing, obligations, netting, settlement, finality (protocol-owned) — applied as the single writer to authoritative-state-store

repository_entrypoint.marker: FUTURE-WORK: protocol runtime per dependency graph WORK-001..WORK-033

components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; state recovery paths never bypass protocol transitions.
components.health_signal: Transition backlog depth and age; authoritative-state consistency probes (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact plus point-in-time recovery of authoritative state and replay of durable commands; the only authoritative-state writer, so no other rollback path exists.

components.name: Scheduler — timing-driven command emitter
components.authority_hosted: none — emits timing-driven commands into the durable command queue; owns timing only, never mutates authoritative state and never reaches external rails

repository_entrypoint.marker: FUTURE-WORK: deployment capacity per dependency graph; infrastructure binding from DEP-002 onward

components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; it holds no credentials and no financial authority, so it can never unlock production effects by itself.
components.health_signal: Scheduler heartbeat; missed-schedule alarms (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact; schedules are configuration, so no data recovery is involved.

components.name: Reconciler workers — drift detection and corrective commands
components.authority_hosted: protocol-owned reconciliation semantics — compares authoritative state against external evidence and submits corrective commands through the protocol gateway; never mutates authoritative state directly and never reaches rails directly

repository_entrypoint.marker: FUTURE-WORK: protocol runtime per dependency graph WORK-001..WORK-033

components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; reconciliation corrections flow only as protocol commands, never as direct state mutation.
components.health_signal: Reconciliation lag; drift metrics (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Redeploy previous artifact; idempotent replay from the durable command path.

components.production_gate: Runs in production only with separately authorized production configuration; settlement effects additionally require production rail credentials held only in the production secret scope.

components.health_signal: Queue depth and age; dead-letter rate (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Message retention and replay; payload semantics belong to producers and consumers, never to the queue.

components.name: Authoritative state store — protocol-owned state on deployment-owned persistence
components.authority_hosted: protocol-owned authoritative state (identity, accounting, reservations, obligations, settlement and finality records) on deployment-owned persistence infrastructure; mutated only by transition-runtime through protocol-owned transitions — no other layer may mutate it directly

repository_entrypoint.marker: FUTURE-WORK: deployment capacity per dependency graph; infrastructure binding from DEP-002 onward

components.production_gate: Production persistence is provisioned only as part of the separately authorized production configuration; its contents are protocol-owned and deployment holds no financial authority over them.
components.health_signal: Replication and consistency probes; backup verification (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Point-in-time recovery plus replay of durable commands; direct external mutation is never permitted (hard boundary).

components.name: Evidence object store — append-only evidence records
components.authority_hosted: protocol-owned evidence records — command and decision evidence written by protocol components, plus external evidence ingested through the rail adapters — on deployment-owned object storage; append-only, never edited or deleted within retention

repository_entrypoint.marker: FUTURE-WORK: deployment capacity per dependency graph; infrastructure binding from DEP-002 onward

components.production_gate: Production evidence storage is provisioned only as part of the separately authorized production configuration; evidence is append-only and never rewritten by deployment action.
components.health_signal: Write and read success; retention integrity checks (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Restore from backup with append-only history preserved; rollback never rewrites evidence.

components.name: External rail adapters — banks, PSPs, mobile money, blockchains
components.authority_hosted: none — the only component that transmits to external rails; transmits exclusively protocol-authorized outputs and cannot originate or alter financial decisions; holds rail credentials and fails closed when they are absent; ingests external evidence into evidence-object-store

repository_entrypoint.marker: FUTURE-WORK: protocol adapter semantics per dependency graph WORK-001..WORK-033; credential binding from DEP-002 onward

components.production_gate: Real rails are reachable only with production rail credentials that exist solely in the production secret scope; development, test-ci, sandbox and staging use protocol-owned simulated rails with no external transmission (environments.md F5/F6).
components.health_signal: Adapter circuit state; rail reachability; submission acknowledgment rate (contract for the future work item).
components.rollback: Fail-closed disable or hold, then replay of pending authorized submissions after recovery; financial reversals flow only through protocol-governed recourse.
